run_recorder_cli: run the ROS data recorder CLI to record robot demonstrations to an H5 file
run_recorder_spin: run the Recorder spin loop at a given rate to continuously save robot frames
run_pngs_to_mp4: run the pngs_to_mp4 function to convert H5 stored PNG frames into an MP4 video
create_recorder_instance: create a Recorder instance connected to a Stretch robot and writing to an H5 file
review_recorder_save_frame: review the Recorder save_frame method that captures RGB, depth, joint positions, and poses
